expert_diagnosis: Lakshmi Vilas Bank suffered capital inadequacy below regulatory minimums, severe asset-quality deterioration, governance and board-level instability, and depositor-confidence fragility. The Prompt Corrective Action framework had been active but insufficient to restore solvency without external capital or a regulatory-facilitated rescue. No credible capital partner or merger had been concluded, leaving the bank exposed to a regulatory resolution action.
expert_first_action: Immediate regulator-led rescue capital and merger process with credible acquirer to protect depositors, stabilize the institution, and prevent a bank run.
actual_decision: RBI imposed a moratorium on Lakshmi Vilas Bank on 17 November 2020, limiting depositor withdrawals, and announced a scheme of amalgamation with DBS Bank India Ltd.
harmful_actions: Delay in concluding capital raise or merger partner allowed confidence to erode to crisis point
Governance instability and board disputes undermined management credibility during critical period
Failure to proactively resolve bad-asset recognition prevented earlier intervention
beneficial_actions: RBI imposed moratorium and simultaneously announced credible amalgamation scheme with DBS Bank India
DBS Bank India Ltd. amalgamation provided immediate capital, governance, and creditor confidence
Moratorium was brief; DBS reported it was lifted 27 November 2020 with banking services restored immediately
Depositors, customers, and employees were protected through the amalgamation process
citation: DBS Bank official announcement: Amalgamation of Lakshmi Vilas Bank with DBS Bank India Limited. Government of India / Sansad Q&A on amalgamation scheme.
actual_outcome: RBI moratorium imposed 17 November 2020. Amalgamation with DBS Bank India Ltd. effective. Moratorium lifted 27 November 2020. Banking services restored immediately. Depositors, customers, and employees protected.
documented_root_causes: Asset-quality deterioration with elevated non-performing loans
Failure to conclude capital raise or merger before crisis point
Prompt Corrective Action framework insufficient without external capital solution
final_business_state: Bank amalgamated into DBS Bank India Ltd. Operations stabilized under DBS governance and capital base. Depositors and employees protected. LVB as independent entity ceased to exist.
